niche.habitat: Ice-shell stress fractures and vent-conduit junctions. Also, in the council's sketch (no such creature in this world yet): Vent-Spinners, both crave stress fractures; fights over anchor points.

body: Jagged crystalline carapace fused to substrate, with three conductive electro-osmotic tendrils pulsing with bioluminescence

skill.effect: The creature absorbs ambient vibrations to steadily build its energy, glowing brighter as it prepares to unleash a powerful attack. It gathers this strength much more rapidly when standing near deep cracks in the terrain.

chains.weakness: Cannot charge if locked to dead ice; must be near stress.
observe: Spine vibrates silently in sync with moon

journal.en: It doesn't hunt; it waits for the moon to strike.

plausibility.summary: Symbionts supply basal metabolism (chemolithotrophy per F26/F20); piezo spine only tops a slow charge reservoir for Lure Flash and strikes. Anchor only on active fractures (weakness already); label piezo output as highly speculative but sufficient for signaling, not for growth.
fixes: Symbionts supply basal metabolism (chemolithotrophy per F26/F20); piezo spine only tops a slow charge reservoir for Lure Flash and strikes. Anchor only on active fractures (weakness already); label piezo output as highly speculative but sufficient for signaling, not for growth.

analogues.organism: Terrestrial bone and tendon (collagen/apatite piezoelectric response under load; Fukada mechanism) — microvolts–millivolts per physiological strain, not whole-body ATP supply; Riftia-style hosts (F26) farm chemolithotrophs for real energy.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

skill.effect: The creature flashes a bright blue light that strongly pulls nearby creatures toward its tendrils.

chains.weakness: Flash reveals position to predators and rivals.
observe: Flash pattern mimics mating pulses of small grazers

journal.en: A heartbeat of light in the eternal dark.

plausibility.summary: Describe trigger as depolarization or Ca²⁺-gated luciferase in tendril photocytes, not literal spark discharge through bulk water; keep 470 nm peak as canon.
fixes: Describe trigger as depolarization or Ca²⁺-gated luciferase in tendril photocytes, not literal spark discharge through bulk water; keep 470 nm peak as canon.

analogues.organism: Deep-sea anglerfish esca lure; dinoflagellate bioluminescence on mechanical or electrical stimulation; Hawaiian bobtail squid (Euprymna scolopes) neural control of symbiotic photophores — lure plus controlled emission, not sunlight counter-illumination.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

skill.effect: Spends charge to fire shockwave. Damages prey and stuns sensitive sensors. Area effect.

chains.weakness: Overcharge risks rupturing membrane; recharge needed.
observe: Water boils briefly at stinger tip

journal.en: A punch of water that hits like rock.

plausibility.summary: Rename to electro-osmotic stun jet: rapid salt/ion pumping drives a small-volume water expulsion and low-frequency pressure pulse (F11) that rattles statocysts and lateral-line analogues; reserve true bubble collapse for vent-conduit ambush only, with micro-bubbles from exsolved gas, not boiling. Drop ‘water boils’ observe line in bulk habitat.

analogues.organism: Mantis shrimp (Odontodactylus) strike and pistol shrimp (Alpheus) snap cavitation work near 1 bar; nematocyst hydrostatic discharge in cnidarians — fast fluid jet and prey penetration without vapour bubbles at depth.

skill.effect: Matches background tidal frequency. Hides from sonar-based enemies. Cannot move.

chains.weakness: Stuck in place; vulnerable to direct strikes.
observe: Skin ripples at exact tidal frequency

journal.en: It sings so perfectly, the world forgets it exists.

plausibility.summary: Phase Lock masks against low-frequency fracture creaks and current hum (passive listeners, vent competitors), not kHz sonar; for Deep Silencers add weakness that only works when predator uses low-band passive detection, or give predator-behavior that hunts piezo emissions/charge hum in a narrow band. Sessile trade-off (cannot move) stays honest.

analogues.organism: Moth scales dampening bat call frequencies (experimental acoustic camouflage); settling fish on noisy reefs — exploit masking bandwidth; not the same as matching a 3.55-day mechanical tide to 50 kHz clicks.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

secrets: Overcharge hack: Hitting the spine with a specific frequency can overload the piezo core, stunning the creature.
Bonding trick: Offering a shard of stressed ice encourages the creature to extend a symbiotic filament, granting passive charge regeneration.
moments: When the tidal flex peaks, the entire population across the ice shell vibrates in unison, a chorus of clicks and hums that resonates through the player's hull, making the moon itself feel alive.
